summary: SUB-08 steps 2-4: proxy handlers to CC <= 15 and deterministic /api/show routing

delivery.outcome: Every function in proxy.py is at radon CC <= 15 (was: _handle_system_one_decide 62, _select_local_system_one_ollama_model 34, OpenAI/Ollama chat and generate handlers 24/22/18, _build_model_resolved_routes 21, _complete_model_direct 20, list_proxy_models 19, do_POST 19, _complete_ollama_system_one 16) via named helpers and a POST route table; monkeypatch seams on subllm.proxy are unchanged. /api/show now decides 'routed' by the exact catalog name, so a slow /api/tags read can no longer turn a local tag into the synthetic remote description (the flaky SUB-06 test).
nonGoals: No change to responses, status codes, routing or failover order.
calibration.py and client_routes.py hotspots are outside SUB-08.

architecture.decision: Refactor in place inside proxy.py (module helpers and handler methods) so tests that monkeypatch subllm.proxy names keep their seams; the POST route table resolves handler methods with getattr so patched methods stay live.

validation.evidence: new /api/show tag-list-timeout test fails on the old handler and passes here
